summary: God gave Moses plans for a special tent called the Tabernacle, where He would live among His people. He filled Bezalel and Oholiab with His Spirit and with skill to build it.

story_reel.narration: Moses stayed on the mountain with God for forty days and forty nights. God gave him amazing plans. 'Let the people make Me a sanctuary, a holy place, so I can live among them.' It would be a beautiful tent called the Tabernacle. Inside would be a golden box called the ark of the covenant, a golden lampstand with cups shaped like almond flowers, a table for special bread, and curtains of blue, purple, and red yarn with angels woven into them. God wanted to live right in the middle of His people's camp! But who could build such a beautiful thing? God said, 'I have chosen Bezalel. I have filled him with My Spirit, with wisdom, understanding, and knowledge, and with skill in every kind of craft: working with gold, silver, and bronze, cutting stones, carving wood, and making all kinds of beautiful things.' God also gave him a partner, Oholiab, and gave skill to all the gifted workers. Isn't that amazing? Being creative and skillful is a gift from God's Spirit. God gave Bezalel his talents for a purpose, and He gives you gifts for a purpose too.

memory_verse.text: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh gives me gifts and skills so I can make beautiful things for Him.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: God filled Bezalel with skill to create. What do you love to make or build?
reflection_choices: Things with blocks, wood, or tools

quiz.question: Why did God want the people to build a sanctuary?
options: So He could live among them
quiz.explanation: God said, 'Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.'

quiz.question: Who did God fill with His Spirit and skill to build the Tabernacle?
quiz.explanation: God said, 'I have called by name Bezalel... I have filled him with the Spirit of God.'

quiz.question: What kinds of skills did God give Bezalel?
options: Working with gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood
quiz.explanation: God gave him skill to work in gold, silver, bronze, cutting stones, and carving wood.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, thank You for the gifts and skills You've given me. Help me use my creativity to make beautiful things that honor You. Amen.

companion.message: Bezalel was amazing! His hands could turn gold into something breathtaking. Your gifts come from God too. What will you create with them?
